t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is a red basket and a yellow basket. The color of the gnomes determine which basket you will get. Red basket is associated with the red, pink, purple, and brown gnomes, and yellow is associated with the yellow, blue, green, and gray gnomes. For a while one of the colors of the basket will give you the most mushrooms. After the mushrooms consistently go down, switch colors and you will get more again

vb_textbox.text: There are two basket colors, red and yellow. The red basket goes with the red, brown, pink, and purple gnome. The yellow basket goes with the yellow, blue, green, and orange gnome. The game will randomly give one basket color more points for a while. Pick one, and consistently choose the gnome with that basket color. Stick with that color until you get only 0-2 mushrooms 5 times in a row. Then switch colors. For me, the red basket got the most mushrooms overall.
